claims.evidence: Paper: immortalized human keratinocyte line 'NTERT1' from van den Bogaard lab. Mapping to Cellosaurus N/TERT-1 (synonym NTERT1) is inferred.
Cellosaurus donor sex for N/TERT-1; not stated in deposit. Age (Cellosaurus '<1M') not a valid pattern: not available.
PRIDE organismParts CL:0000312 keratinocyte; Cellosaurus derived-from site skin epidermis (UBERON:0001003).
Matrix is conditioned medium of differentiated NTERT1 cells treated with 10 ng/mL IL-4/-13 for 3 days.
Paper compares IL-4/-13 treated vs nontreated conditioned medium but no file-to-condition map is in the deposit or paper text.
File names Pulldown_FL/deltaC/CTR map to PN FL, PN deltaCTD and the third bait PN CTD (three baits, triplicates, no beads-only control described). CTR=CTD is inferred.
Paper: pull-down in triplicate, each replicate analysed twice; two acquisition dates. Date order to technical replicate number is inferred.
Paper: three gel lanes each cut into 10 pieces. Lane letter to lane content (CM alone / +PN CTD / +PN FAS-CTD) is not stated: bait not available.
Sample processing: trypsin only (spin-filter, in-solution and in-gel digests).

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M, Acetyl protein N-term, Met-loss variable
claims.evidence: PRIDE data processing protocol (Proteome Discoverer 2.5/SequestHT). The deposited .msf files (0.9-6 GB) were not opened.
Label-free DDA on Orbitrap Eclipse; inferred from experiment type and SequestHT search.
126 deposited files; 60 RAW each claimed once. .mgf and .msf excluded.

limitations: NTERT_R1-R12 (12 RAW) are not mapped to IL-4/-13 treated vs untreated or to replicates; treatment is not available and biological replicate = file index (placeholder numbering).
Pull-down 'CTR' bait inferred to be PN CTD; tech replicate by acquisition date inferred.
Native PAGE lane letters A/B/C not mapped to sample content; bait/treatment factor not available for those lanes beyond cell treatment.
Gel-band fractionation has no suitable PRIDE:0000550 child for native PAGE: fractionation method not available.
characteristics[treatment] 'interleukin-4 and interleukin-13' is a compound value not found in NCIT/EFO (validator warning); N/TERT-1 not found in CLO/BTO/EFO (warning).
Search parameters taken from PRIDE protocol text; deposited .msf not inspected. Dissociation method not stated: not available. Age: not available.
Not previously annotated in sdrf-annotated-datasets (no PXD040164 directory). Independent review pending.
